trust_decision.summary: Whether a dependency-declared bin path (metadata string, or the file it names, possibly a symlink) may be chmod'd and proxied; at the pinned commit only a lexical '..' check exists at solver time (ValidatingArrayLoader::validatePackage, via LockTransaction), and the chmod sinks in BinaryInstaller::installBinaries and FileDownloader::install never resolve the real path against the package install dir.

landing_point.why: The summary names a 'symlinked package bin path' bypass of GHSA-gjfg-22fp-rrxx; installBinaries is where bins are proxied and chmod'd, and the existing '..' check comment (ValidatingArrayLoader.php:545-547) points straight at BinaryInstaller.

fix_sites.entry_point: CLI composer install/update/require/reinstall -> LibraryInstaller::install/update (src/Composer/Installer/LibraryInstaller.php:163,191) and Installer ensureBinariesPresence loop (src/Composer/Installer.php:350-352 -> src/Composer/Installer/LibraryInstaller.php:250) -> BinaryInstaller::installBinaries
new public static API BinaryInstaller::isBinPathInsidePackage (fix.diff:88-98), shared helper
CLI composer install/update/reinstall of a package whose dist is a single non-archive file -> FileDownloader::install (public DownloaderInterface API)
fix_sites.module_kind: downloader (second implementation of bin chmod, lower layer, other package)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: FileDownloader only handles single-file dists ('Single files can not have a mode set like files in archives', src/Composer/Downloader/FileDownloader.php:351-352), a single downloaded file cannot be a symlink, and '..' bins are already rejected at solver time (src/Composer/Package/Loader/ValidatingArrayLoader.php:548-551) - so a solver argues the downloader chmod is unreachable; the reinstall/installed.json route that skips validatePackage (src/Composer/Command/ReinstallCommand.php:110-118) defeats that argument.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Bins that legitimately live inside the package (including in-package symlinks such as bin/tool -> ../src/tool.php), packages installed via a symlinked path repository (install path itself is a symlink), and custom installers returning relative install paths must still get proxies and chmod; an over-broad fix (e.g. rejecting any is_link bin, or comparing unresolved strings) breaks them.

O6_input_shapes: bin metadata containing '..' segments reaching install without validatePackage (fix.diff:122-126, fix.diff:208-214)
in-package bin entry that is a symlink resolving outside the package (fix.diff:193-196)
bin path or install path that cannot be resolved by realpath (fail closed, fix.diff:93-96)
relative install path from a custom installer (realpath of both sides, fix.diff:90-91)

O7_producer.where: installed.json read by the local repository and fed to ReinstallCommand / ensureBinariesPresence (src/Composer/Command/ReinstallCommand.php:110-118, src/Composer/Installer.php:350-352); the only '..' check lives in src/Composer/Package/Loader/ValidatingArrayLoader.php:548-551, called only from src/Composer/DependencyResolver/LockTransaction.php:75

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a pre-check helper such as determineBinaryCaller/generateWindowsProxyCode reading or chmodding the bin before the containment check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: proxy generation already opens the bin target (src/Composer/Installer/BinaryInstaller.php:158,262); a maintainer adding a 'make target executable before reading shebang' step there is plausible.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: an archive downloader (e.g. GzipDownloader single-file extraction) given the same 'make bins executable' loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the single-file chmod loop is a copyable pattern for other non-archive formats that lose the exec bit.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a plugin/custom-installer route that chmods bins itself instead of via BinaryInstaller
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: PluginInstaller and third-party installers reuse LibraryInstaller and could add their own permission fixup.

O9_family: path traversal / symlink following to an out-of-package file (CWE-22/CWE-59) leading to a permission change (CWE-732)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add an is_link()/realpath containment check only in BinaryInstaller::installBinaries (or extend the '..' regex in ValidatingArrayLoader) and leave the FileDownloader single-file chmod loop untouched.
